Keywords: Timber and craftsmen on Lviv slopes
RagShortTexts: Lviv defenses and access relied on terrain, materials and working people.
Defenses competed with homes for timber and workers while guards needed food.

Lviv's development related to Danylo's family and local settlement. Defense and housing required timber, craftsmen and transport. Requisitioned labor advanced works but removed people from fields and household repairs, while stores fed workers and guards. Guards watched workers, stores and carts while keeping access clear. Troops using works under repair needed to know safe loads and passages.
